title: Clock and Compass
author: Kestrel Joubert
blurb: Mara Montrose, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ice breaks on the river.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
